hypotheses.rationale: A LoRA rank of 16 may be insufficient to capture the distinctions needed among 77 intent labels, causing the model to confuse similar intents as seen in the wrong answers.

The learning rate of 6e-6 is far below the typical ~1e-4 effective for LoRA, resulting in slow weight updates; although loss decreases, the model may not fully separate classes, leading to low accuracy.

If training examples used a chat template with special tokens but inference expects only the label, the model may generate label-like strings but occasionally select a wrong intent due to token misalignment.
